1.1.95 update instructions

A. By cable, go to
www.locklinestudio.com/
radar/update
& use password "takeoff"

B. On the radar (may not always work):
1. Settings > Map: off.
2. Set the range to 1.
3. Unplug 10 s, plug in.
4. Settings > System > Check for update, then Install.
Repeat 3 and 4 if it fails.
